CASE STUDY

Open live prototype

Context

ReplyFlow explores a calmer way to help small teams handle everyday customer questions across multiple languages.

Problem

A useful prototype needed to be honest about what was automated while still making the response-selection flow feel tangible.

Solution

The current prototype uses clearly labelled, preset templates with friendly and professional response directions.

My contribution

Designed and prototyped an interaction model around labelled template responses and tone-aware selection.

Architecture

A front-end product prototype focused on interaction states, language cues, and clear content hierarchy.

Challenges

Making the “AI” concept legible without representing planned live generation as an implemented capability.

Lessons learned

Trust improves when a product names the difference between what exists today and what is planned.
